scope_ko: 영상 참고의 길게 뻗는 공중기와 배 아래 모이는 공중기, 짝 앞발 지지에서 뒷발 착지로 이어지는 흐름을 Run에 다시 제작했습니다. 원본과 이전 제작/수출 파일, rest geometry/weights/morph/coat, care와 Walk 키는 보존했습니다.
scope_en: Run was re-authored around the observed extended and collected suspension, close fore-pair support and hind landing. Source and prior productions/exports, rest geometry/weights/morph/coat, care and Walk keys are preserved.

clip.name: Run
clip.root_motion: in-place; smoothly authored vertical body and spinal flex
clip.source: Captured nonuniform paw profile, filtered periodic and phase-warped for paired fore/hind reference rhythm. Body envelope, scapular glide, calibrated phase carpal/toe pitch and source boundary contact correction are authored. Video display timing is a visual pacing guide; overlay speed and source marker flight are not physical ground truth.

independent_review.root_still_gate: Ten new actual skin side poses accepted as an improvement; final movie/reference flow gate pending.

capture_attribution.dataset: Han et al.2024 canine motion capture / CC BY 4.0
capture_attribution.movie_policy: Browser-observed posture/rhythm only; movie not downloaded, reproduced or embedded. Displayed speed is not a measured source velocity.

method: Measured nonuniform source ankle and toe paths are periodic Fourier filtered and phase warped per limb. Quintic boundary correction joins translation-cancelling stance with continuous position/first/second derivatives. Authored periodic cubic B-spline hip/spine and scapular curves replace per-frame reach-driven pelvis lowering. The acquired limb lengths and rest bend directions are retained; paw pitch is calibrated, phase-defined and no 3D source ankle quaternion is copied. Connected neck lean lowers the nose while keeping the head shape.
limits: This is a reference-guided animation adaptation, not motion capture of the video dog.
The Labrador has a much longer spine and shorter humerus than the captured dog. Original proportions and vertex weights constrain how deeply its wrist can fold.
Nominal speed is adapted captured stride divided by .70-second authored duration; video overlay velocity is not used.
Support skin drift must be reported as bounded measured drift after independent review, not absolute zero skating.
Unity integration, playable preview, final movie and publication are owned by root and another agent.
public_contact_summary_ko: 실제 캡처의 비균일 발 궤적을 래브라도 체형과 영상의 리듬에 맞게 조정한 창작 모션입니다. Run은 .70초 주기로 전·후지 짝 지지와 두 공중기 형태를 가지며, 제자리 재생 기준 이동속도는 2.347m/s입니다. 자체31검사와 독립169피부 표본에서 관절 방향·접지·코어 연속성을 확인했습니다. 실제 고정 발바닥 중심 이동오차는 최대1.67mm이며, 발/바닥 완전무오차를 주장하지 않습니다.
public_contact_summary_en: This authored adaptation fits captured nonuniform paw trajectories to the Labrador proportions and observed movie rhythm. The .70-second Run pairs fore/hind support with distinct extended and collected suspension, at 2.347 m/s nominal in-place speed. 31 own checks and 169 independent skin samples verify joint directions, support and core continuity. Maximum fixed-sole centroid drift is 1.67 mm; absolute zero skating is not claimed.

cleanup_after_final_movie_gate.other_agents_own: Final movie/posters, independent review receipts/logs, editor logs and Unity fixture outputs are used by other agents. Do not delete before the root final movie/reference gate.
